definition: אֶלְקוֺשִׁי adjective, of a people with article Nahum the Elkoshite Nah 1:1 (perhaps = from Elkosh , but locality unknown; identified by Jer Comm. with a village Elcesi in Galilee; compare also Capernaum (= כְּפַר נַחוּם ?); others (improbably) with an Elkosh on east bank of Tigris, near Mosul). ** On etymology, and site of place, see Da Nahum, etc., 9 ff. GASm Twelve Proph. ii. 79f .
